name: @kibkalo/tack
description: Click. Comment. Feed to AI. Ultra-lightweight webpage annotation tool.
author: kibkalo.com

scripts.build:js: esbuild tack.js --minify --banner:js="/*! Tack — Click. Comment. Feed to AI. https://gettack.dev | MIT */" --outfile=tack.min.js --allow-overwrite
scripts.build: npm run build:js && cp tack.min.js public/tack.js && astro build
scripts.test:site: npm run build && node test/site.mjs && node test/mobile.mjs
